title: NYISO HUD VL: day-ahead minus real-time by hour
subtitle: Mean spread for each local hour, 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-26, USD/MWh
source_line: Source: NYISO via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), tables nyiso_dam_zone_prices, nyiso_rtm_zone_prices; data retrieved to 2026-09-28.
citations: New York Independent System Operator (NYISO). damlbmp: Day-Ahead Market LBMP, zonal (P-2A). http://mis.nyiso.com/public/P-2Alist.htm. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table nyiso_dam_zone_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.

New York Independent System Operator (NYISO). realtime: Real-Time Market LBMP, zonal, RTD 5-minute (P-24A). http://mis.nyiso.com/public/P-24Alist.htm. Retrieved 2026-09-28 via the Energy Research Warehouse (ERW), table nyiso_rtm_zone_prices, data commit 2c667859235e.
facts: NYISO HUD VL, 2026-08-28 to 2026-09-26: the mean day-ahead minus real-time spread was highest in the hour starting 19:00 local, 10.8 USD/MWh, and lowest in the hour starting 17:00, -8.85 USD/MWh.
Mean spread over all hours, 2026-09-20 to 2026-09-26: 8.35 USD/MWh.
